event_suggestions_city_length.name: event_suggestions_city_length
event_suggestions_city_length.value: "event_suggestions"."city" is null or char_length("event_suggestions"."city") between 1 and 60

event_suggestions_venue_length.name: event_suggestions_venue_length
event_suggestions_venue_length.value: "event_suggestions"."venue" is null or char_length("event_suggestions"."venue") between 1 and 120

events_city_length.name: events_city_length
events_city_length.value: "events"."city" is null or char_length("events"."city") between 1 and 60

events_venue_length.name: events_venue_length
events_venue_length.value: "events"."venue" is null or char_length("events"."venue") between 1 and 120

job_checks_url.name: job_checks_url
job_checks_url.value: "job_checks"."url" is null or ("job_checks"."url" like 'https://%' and char_length("job_checks"."url") <= 2000)

job_checks_city_length.name: job_checks_city_length
job_checks_city_length.value: "job_checks"."city" is null or char_length("job_checks"."city") between 1 and 60

job_email_checks_lengths.name: job_email_checks_lengths
job_email_checks_lengths.value: char_length("job_email_checks"."employer") between 1 and 120 and char_length("job_email_checks"."employer_key") between 1 and 120 and char_length("job_email_checks"."domain") between 3 and 253

job_saves_not_empty.name: job_saves_not_empty
job_saves_not_empty.value: "job_saves"."saved_at" is not null or "job_saves"."stage" is not null

job_saves_note_length.name: job_saves_note_length
job_saves_note_length.value: "job_saves"."note" is null or char_length("job_saves"."note") between 1 and 2000

market_openings_monthly_city.name: market_openings_monthly_city
market_openings_monthly_city.value: "market_openings_monthly"."city" is null or (char_length("market_openings_monthly"."city") between 1 and 60 and "market_openings_monthly"."state" <> 'IN')

me_education_year_length.name: me_education_year_length
me_education_year_length.value: "me_education"."year" is null or char_length("me_education"."year") between 1 and 40

mock_answers_follow_up_needs_id.name: mock_answers_follow_up_needs_id
mock_answers_follow_up_needs_id.value: "mock_answers"."follow_up_answer" is null or "mock_answers"."follow_up_id" is not null

notifications_refs.name: notifications_refs
notifications_refs.value: num_nonnulls("notifications"."connection_request_id", "notifications"."application_id", "notifications"."interview_id", "notifications"."post_id", "notifications"."comment_id", "notifications"."report_id", "notifications"."appeal_id") = 1 and (("notifications"."kind" in ('connection_request', 'connection_accepted') and "notifications"."connection_request_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."kind" in ('application_moved', 'application_closed') and "notifications"."application_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."kind" in ('interview_scheduled', 'interview_cancelled') and "notifications"."interview_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."kind" in ('junction_comment', 'junction_post_hidden') and "notifications"."post_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."kind" = 'junction_comment_hidden' and "notifications"."comment_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."kind" = 'junction_appeal_decided' and "notifications"."appeal_id" is not null) or ("notifications"."kind" in ('report_decided', 'report_filed') and "notifications"."report_id" is not null))

org_invites_shape.name: org_invites_shape
org_invites_shape.value: ("org_invites"."kind" = 'invite') = ("org_invites"."email_hash" is not null) and ("org_invites"."kind" = 'request') = ("org_invites"."user_id" is not null)

resource_suggestions_decline_reason.name: resource_suggestions_decline_reason
resource_suggestions_decline_reason.value: ("resource_suggestions"."status" = 'declined') = ("resource_suggestions"."decline_reason" is not null) and ("resource_suggestions"."decline_reason" is null or "resource_suggestions"."decline_reason" in ('not_free', 'paywall', 'affiliate', 'off_topic', 'other'))

shared_job_holds_url.name: shared_job_holds_url
shared_job_holds_url.value: "shared_job_holds"."url" is null or ("shared_job_holds"."url" like 'https://%' and char_length("shared_job_holds"."url") <= 2000)

stories_parts_length.name: stories_parts_length
stories_parts_length.value: char_length("stories"."situation") <= 400 and char_length("stories"."task") <= 400 and char_length("stories"."action") <= 400 and char_length("stories"."result") <= 400

story_boxes_box.name: story_boxes_box
story_boxes_box.value: "story_boxes"."box" in ('Ownership', 'Problem solving', 'Delivering results', 'Learning', 'Working with others', 'Speaking up')

user_resources_not_empty.name: user_resources_not_empty
user_resources_not_empty.value: "user_resources"."saved_at" is not null or "user_resources"."finished_at" is not null or "user_resources"."on_ride_at" is not null

user_settings_resigned_needs_days.name: user_settings_resigned_needs_days
user_settings_resigned_needs_days.value: "user_settings"."resigned_on" is null or "user_settings"."notice_days" is not null

junction_posts_link.name: junction_posts_link
junction_posts_link.value: "junction_posts"."link_url" is null or ("junction_posts"."link_url" like 'https://%' and char_length("junction_posts"."link_url") <= 500 and "junction_posts"."link_host" is not null)
